title: Turkish Pilaf with Luscious Tomatoes
description: A flavorful and aromatic Turkish-inspired pilaf dish loaded with juicy tomatoes and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add Turkish pilaf and stir to combine with tomato mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Optional: Add a sprinkle of sumac for added flavor and color.
